purpose: Teach: 安売り/値動き/外装/試用/贈呈/発案/損得/取り立て

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、安売り商品の中の偽造品を捜査されますね
lines.en: The police investigate counterfeit goods mixed in with discount items.
lines.style: Clear, factual tone. Straightforward delivery with slight appreciation underneath. Measured pace, steady eye contact. Speaking as an equal, not deferential.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、株式の値動きで詐欺が増える事案にも対応されますね
lines.en: The police handle cases where fraud increases with stock market volatility.
lines.style: Same measured, appreciative clarity. Acknowledging complexity without slowing down. Warmth in recognizing their work, not in performance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、街灯の外装を防犯仕様にして下さってますね
lines.en: You've fitted the streetlights with crime-prevention exteriors.
lines.style: Noticing something concrete. Slight lift of approval. Direct, not overstated. The tone of someone who actually sees what's been done.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、新防犯機材の試用、ありがたいです
lines.en: We're really grateful for the trial of your new crime-prevention equipment.
lines.style: Genuine gratitude breaking through slightly. Warm but measured. 'Really' lands with quiet sincerity, not performance. Slight lean forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、感謝状の贈呈もされますね
lines.en: I notice you present commendation certificates too.
lines.style: Observant, appreciative. Listing facts but with warm recognition. Not reciting — conversing. Slight pause before the observation lands.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民発案の防犯活動を支援されますね
lines.en: You support crime-prevention efforts that come from the community itself.
lines.style: Quiet approval. Emphasizing 'community' with slight warmth. Measured, steady. The tone of someone noting something that matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、損得勘定で動かれないご姿勢、頼もしいです
lines.en: Your willingness to act on principle, not profit — that's what makes you reliable.
lines.style: Firmer than before. Sincere admiration breaking through. Not flattering — stating something observed. Direct eye contact. Weight in the delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、悪質な取り立てを捜査されますね
lines.style: Tone shifts. Quieter, closer. More personal investment. Less observation, more gravity. The shift from 'they' to 'you' — more intimate recognition of what matters.
